roundCodes.LAGS: League A Group Stage (UEFA Nations League)
roundCodes.Q: Qualification decider (a match that could decide qualification, e.g. to the World Cup or Euros)

coverageWords.full: Every match in this competition/tier is included, including qualifying rounds for continental competitions.
coverageWords.all: Same as "full" — every match included. (Kept as a separate word in the data only because the source sheet wasn't fully consistent between the two.)
coverageWords.top: Matches from the round when top-tier/big clubs enter the competition onward, any round, regardless of opponent.

O.name: Odds-based
O.template: Both teams' decimal win odds are {N} or lower.
O.scope: Only used for the Important tier of the Top-Tier league in the five leagues that have one (England, Spain, Germany, Italy, France), and only for the first half of the season — see the ranking methodology note.

S.name: Combined ranking
S.template: The two teams' rankings add up to {N} or less.
S.scope: Domestic leagues: league standing position. International matches: FIFA world ranking. See the ranking methodology note for how "ranking" is determined through the season.

T.name: Individual top-ranked team
T.template: At least one of the two teams is individually ranked {N} or better — this match counts regardless of who the opponent is.
T.scope: Domestic leagues: current league standing (or FIFA/individual competition ranking depending on context). International matches (T30 specifically): either team's FIFA world ranking.

C.name: Title decider
C.template: A match that could decide the competition's champion.
C.scope: Used across domestic league/cup columns and one international entry (EAFF E-1 Championship).

separator.meaning: OR — a match qualifies for a tier if it satisfies ANY of the slash-separated conditions in that cell. The same OR logic applies between the per-row rules and the global cutoffs below: if a match satisfies either, it's included.

domestic: Combined real-time market value of both teams ≥ €500M — promotes a match to the Important tier regardless of country, competition, or round.
continental: Combined real-time market value of both teams ≥ €300M — promotes a match to the Important tier regardless of competition or round.
international: Combined real-time market value of both teams ≥ €300M, OR
Combined FIFA world ranking of both teams ≤ 120 (this is the same "S" logic as S120), OR
Either team's FIFA world ranking ≤ 30 (this is the same "T" logic as T30)
— any of these promotes a match to the Important tier regardless of competition or round.
globalCutoffs.note: These global cutoffs sit outside the per-competition Important/Main/Supplementary columns in the source sheet, so which exact tier they promote to is Claude's best reading of the intent (Important, the top tier) rather than something explicitly labelled — worth Xuhui double-checking.

rankingMethodology: Matchdays 1–7 of a league season: use the previous season's final standings. (Doesn't apply to leagues without a stable prior-season basis, such as the EFL Championship, where promoted/relegated teams make last season's table not meaningfully comparable.)
Matchday 8 onward: use real-time, current-season standings.
For leagues with more than two round-robins in a season (e.g. leagues that split into championship/relegation groups): only the standings from the last two round-robins are used.

For Important-tier qualification specifically: only the final round-robin's standings are used for the ranking (S) rule. Before that point in the season, the odds-based (O) rule is used instead for the Important tier — this only affects the five leagues with an Important-tier column at all (England, Spain, Germany, Italy, France).
